allow: PowerShell($r = sf project deploy report --json 2>&1 | ConvertFrom-Json; $res = $r.result; Write-Output "status:    $\($res.status\)"; Write-Output "success:   $\($res.success\)"; Write-Output "components:$\($res.numberComponentsDeployed\)/$\($res.numberComponentsTotal\)"; Write-Output "errors:    $\($res.numberComponentErrors\)"; if \($res.details.componentFailures\) { Write-Output "--- FAILURES ---"; $res.details.componentFailures | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "$\($_.fullName\): $\($_.problem\)" } })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== lwc dir ==="; Get-ChildItem "force-app\\main\\default\\lwc" -Force; Write-Output "`n=== classes dir ==="; \(Get-ChildItem "force-app\\main\\default\\classes" -Force -File\).Count; Write-Output "`n=== full force-app file count ==="; \(Get-ChildItem force-app -Recurse -File\).Count)

PowerShell(sf project deploy start -d force-app --dry-run --ignore-conflicts --test-level RunLocalTests --json 2>&1 | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\\deploy_result.json" -Encoding utf8; $r = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\deploy_result.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $d = $r.result; Write-Output "status: $\($d.status\)"; Write-Output "success: $\($d.success\)"; Write-Output "components: $\($d.numberComponentsDeployed\)/$\($d.numberComponentsTotal\), errors: $\($d.numberComponentErrors\)"; Write-Output "tests: $\($d.numberTestsCompleted\)/$\($d.numberTestsTotal\), failures: $\($d.numberTestErrors\)"; if \($d.details.runTestResult.codeCoverage\) { $d.details.runTestResult.codeCoverage | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.name\): $\($_.numLocationsCovered\)/\($\($_.numLocationsCovered\)+$\($_.numLocationsNotCovered\)\)" } })

PowerShell(sf project deploy start -d force-app --ignore-conflicts --test-level RunLocalTests --json 2>&1 | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\\deploy_real.json" -Encoding utf8; $r = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\deploy_real.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $d = $r.result; Write-Output "status: $\($d.status\)"; Write-Output "success: $\($d.success\)"; Write-Output "components: $\($d.numberComponentsDeployed\)/$\($d.numberComponentsTotal\), errors: $\($d.numberComponentErrors\)"; Write-Output "tests: $\($d.numberTestsCompleted\)/$\($d.numberTestsTotal\), failures: $\($d.numberTestErrors\)"; if \($d.details.componentFailures\) { $d.details.componentFailures | ForEach-Object { "FAIL: $\($_.fullName\) - $\($_.problem\)" } }; if \($d.details.runTestResult.failures\) { $d.details.runTestResult.failures | ForEach-Object { "TEST FAIL: $\($_.name\).$\($_.methodName\) - $\($_.message\)" } })
PowerShell(sf apex run test --class-names AccStatusTest --class-names AccAdminCommandCenterControllerTest --result-format human --code-coverage --wait 10 2>&1)
